confidence_explanation: The evidence shows a clear pattern of brute-force attempts followed by a successful login from an unusual IP, immediate privilege escalation, bulk downloading of files within the user's department, and subsequent log deletion to cover tracks. Additionally, user_05 exhibited highly suspicious cross-departmental data access patterns.

attack_chain.description: Brute-force attack attempt via multiple failed login attempts from an unusual IP (185.220.101.45) targeting user_09.
Successful login for user_09 from the suspicious IP.
Unauthorized privilege escalation to an 'elevated' role.
Bulk exfiltration of marketing department files following privilege escalation.
Deletion of authentication logs (/var/log/auth.log) to conceal malicious activity.

gaps: Confirmation of whether user_09's credentials were stolen or if this was an insider threat.
Verification of whether user_05's cross-departmental access was part of a separate, coordinated incident or a secondary insider threat.
narrative: An attacker successfully compromised user_09's account via brute-force from an external IP, escalated privileges, and exfiltrated multiple marketing files before deleting authentication logs. Simultaneously, user_05 engaged in highly suspicious behavior by downloading files from the legal, finance, and HR departments, which are outside their normal sales scope.
